name: Ship 2
author: AAidalol
description: An extremely buffed remake of Aida's old level 'ship', convienently named 'Ship 2'. has, in Aida's words, 'Avernus ahh hitboxes' in the first straightfly. looks rather intimidating, but is much easier than it seems. Also the first level Aida verified with the seahorse ship. Hardest part is obviously 0-29.
